scope: Reconcile official DXF 3DSOLID carrier fields, FreeCAD documentation/source/runtime evidence boundaries, and mesh projection versus solid semantics; refine existing consumer gates only.

method.kind: Read-only primary documentation and source review
method.evidenceBoundary: Documentation and mutable source establish declared or implemented routes only. No current FreeCAD runtime, DXF file, ACIS payload, or native application behavior was qualified. Current-main documentation/source are not immutable release evidence.

observed: The documented record contains an AcDbModelerGeometry subclass, modeler format version, proprietary group 1 data with optional group 3 continuation chunks, then AcDb3dSolid and a soft-owner history handle.
This public entity table does not specify the embedded SAT/SAB grammar or establish semantic validity.
findings.planUse: Keep ordered carrier chunks, payload, and history ownership independently checked; do not infer B-rep support from outer-record parsing.

observed: Current documentation labels DWG and DXF support as 2D-only.

The current mutable C++ DXF importer source contains explicit shape-construction paths, but source inspection does not identify a reproducible application version, backend selection, or runtime result.
This documentation/source scope mismatch does not supersede the repository's already pinned FreeCAD runtime outcomes for their exact inputs.
findings.planUse: At the existing optional composed consumer checkpoint, qualify a pinned runtime/backend using separate locally-generated planar, tilted, and non-planar 3DFACE controls, and inspect geometry/topology and warnings rather than file-open success. If unavailable, record NOT_RUN and continue.

findings.route: FreeCAD MeshObject and ezdxf mesh-derived ACIS
observed: FreeCAD documentation distinguishes a MeshObject from a solid Shape and notes that a surface mesh does not itself carry solid mass semantics.
ezdxf can create a polyhedral ACIS body from a mesh and project only flat polygonal faces back to meshes; curved faces require a kernel and are lost by that projection.
The DXF file-structure notes do not define the internals of the R2013+ ACDSDATA section.
findings.planUse: Keep mesh/tessellation as a derived projection axis. Preserve the original ACIS carrier separately or refuse transactionally; record source mapping, transforms/units, tolerance, and open/closed disposition.

nextActions: Continue the existing local implementation queue without waiting for current FreeCAD or external kernel availability.
At the composed S8 consumer checkpoint, run explicit-face controls only under an exact pinned FreeCAD runtime/backend; keep mesh projection and ACIS/B-rep claims separate.
Do not replace or silently downgrade an ACIS carrier to a mesh in default output; preserve it independently or fail transactionally.
